text: Chief takes it: Laminar app shell over the static edition, in a storyatlas4s worktree agent; design constraints: DOM text rail is the edition's codex HTML structure (one span per fragment, V-T2), Intaglio SVG overlay per page, epistemic playhead = ReaderAt horizon selector re-compiling via the view module's CodexCompiler/AtlasCompiler in JS (no server), zoom levels for the Atlas; no inference in the app; receipts displayed.
